_doc: Battle Tower lobby (Sapphire 14x9, zone 21), a plain Sapphire room for now (the PWT link waits for the island and the story, notes/DECISIONS.md): Nimbasa's Battle Test look (texture set 306). Row 1 = the row along the back wall: the door to the battle room (6,1) = Black 2's blue double door door_h5_in (Sapphire warp 2, entered from the south), the PC (11,1) = pc01. The U-shaped reception counter (3 and 9, rows 2-5; 4-5 and 7-8, row 5; the receptionist in the gap at 6,5) = white counters shelf03; the sofa along the east wall (13, 4-6) = red armchairs; plants (0-1, 12-13 at row 8). Exits (6-7, 8) lead to the island (BattleTower_Outside, not built yet). Doors (pwt_tower, 2026-10-11): "doorway": true cuts each door_h5_in's width out of the back wall with a black recess behind it (models_interior.py doorway_spans), so the halves swing open into a dark doorway as in Black 2's League (chunk 899) instead of into the wall; the doors stand 1 unit inside the doorway (gap -1) and 1 lower (y -1, top under the wall's black cap), so no edge of a swung half shows over the wall top.
